problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex set Q. The differentiable function f is convex on the entire ambient space, and ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists; strong convexity is not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: objective; spec.admissible convexity and minimizer clauses.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines a continuously differentiable convex component f with a potentially nonsmooth convex component ψ and the constraint x∈Q.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A gradient query at any x returns ∇f(x) exactly, independently of the call index and oracle seed. No function-value oracle is supplied.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Query.gradient; spec.admissible gradient-answer and HasGradientAt clauses.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For every a>0 and z,v, an exact proximal query returns a minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Each gradient or proximal query counts as one oracle call within a fixed budget.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Query.prox; proxObjective; spec.admissible proximal clauses. LongTails/Template.lean: execute; Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: L0>0 and L1≥0. For any segment [x,y] on which ‖∇f‖≤M, ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1M)‖x−y‖. The gradient is continuous; twice differentiability and global Lipschitz continuity of the gradient are not assumed.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.valid; spec.admissible gradient-continuity and segment-smoothness clauses.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary real Hilbert space. Public information comprises E,L0,L1,R,Δ,x0, with R,Δ>0. Some minimizer x⋆ satisfies ‖x0−x⋆‖≤R, F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, and ‖∇f(x⋆)‖≤G, where G≥0 may be nonzero. G and ε>0 are hidden from algorithm construction; neither Q nor ψ is supplied explicitly as public input.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: Public; Params; spec.publicInput; spec.valid; spec.admissible minimizer clause. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.makeAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point satisfies F(output)−F(x⋆)≤ε for a minimizer x⋆ of F over Q.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point belongs to Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the ε objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law. Algorithm randomization is permitted; the oracle-call budget is fixed and holds for every seed.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.lean: spec.successful almost-everywhere clause. LongTails/Template.lean: Algorithm; Convergence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Composite convex proximal optimization is standard, but this formulation uses gradient-dependent segment smoothness in an arbitrary Hilbert space, permits a nonzero smooth-component gradient at a composite minimizer, and hides G and ε from algorithm construction.
